# ZBD Solutions - zbdconsulting.com

> Office tools that Wake County trades own outright, plus a free website check and straight answers. Built around how your shop already works, paid for once.

## What It Is
ZBD Solutions builds small custom office tools for contractors and trades in Wake County, North Carolina (roofing, HVAC, plumbing, electrical, landscaping, painting, general contracting). The tools save to the computer they run on, use no AI services, and belong to the customer. If you stop working with us, the tool keeps working. Based in Raleigh.

## Services
- Custom Tools: Starter Tool (one job, one team, one list or spreadsheet) $1,950. Everyday Tool $2,950 - $3,450. Bigger Tool (several steps, imports and exports spreadsheets, reports) $4,250 - $5,250. Paid once. Setup and training at your shop (optional) $750 - $1,250. Monthly upkeep and changes (optional) $275 - $475/mo, 30 days' notice to stop.
- Advice and Plans: Quick Answer (20-minute call and written recap) $89. Strategic Plan (60 to 90 minutes and a written plan) $229. Custom Build (a few days of work and a finished result) $549 - $749.
- Hired Help, Managed (limited availability): we find the help and check the work. $65 - $95/hr for managing, 20 - 35% added to the freelancer's cost, or a fixed project price set per job.
- Free website check: we look at your website and email from the outside and send a one-page plain-English report. No cost, no obligation.
